Day 180: Six months free, plan complete

One hundred and eighty days. Six full months without a single cigarette, nicotine free, and the complete guided plan finished from start to end. You did not give something up; you got yourself back. Every tool stays in your pocket for life, but you walk out of here as what you now simply are: a non smoker.
